pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, The Heart of the Andes — the whole world opening away in light from the flowers at your feet to the snow peak, bless the LORD O my soul, O LORD my God You are very great
pictures.name: pd_church_ziel

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, The Transfiguration — Christ standing changed on the hill with the light coming off Him, You are clothed with splendor and majesty, He wraps Himself in light as with a garment
pictures.name: pd_bellini_luister

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, Wheat Fields — the enormous sky pitched over the corn like a tent, He stretches out the heavens like a tent, laying the beams of His chambers
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_tent

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Vision of Ezekiel — God borne up through the cloud on the living creatures, in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot
pictures.name: pd_rafael_wagen

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Archangel Raphael Leaving Tobias' Family — the angel going up into the air on great wings while the family falls back, walking on the wings of the wind, He makes the winds His messengers
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_wind

pictures.scene: Dieric Bouts the Elder, Moses and the Burning Bush — the bush standing in flame and not burning up while Moses takes off his shoes, flames of fire His servants
pictures.name: pd_bouts_vuur

lines.text: Bless the LORD, O my soul!
O LORD my God, You are very great;
You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
He wraps Himself in light as with a garment;
He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
laying the beams of His chambers
walking on the wings of the wind.
He makes the winds His messengers,
